fact: Maroc Telecom's completed 5,700 km terrestrial cable runs from Morocco to Niger via Mauritania, Mali and Burkina Faso (Mali on the route, not named as an end), and lets the Moov Africa subsidiary in landlocked Mali connect to international bandwidth through the Maroc Telecom network; investment about MAD 1 billion, 2020 to 2022.

SENUM SA (Senegal) and SMTD-SA (Mali) inaugurated the interconnection of their national fibre-optic backbones at the Kidira-Diboli border bridge on Monday 2026-10-05, described by a speaker as the putting into service of the infrastructure; no capacity or traffic figure is given.
